fld_description: On-effort segment identifier, unique across cruises; primary key. Sightings reference it.
Survey label CCYYYY-MM (e.g. CC2004-07); the canonical label, which the sightings take from their segment.
notes: cruise_key is resolved from the ship track, not parsed from the label

fld_description: Season of the cruise (winter, spring, summer, fall), lower-cased.
Year of the segment start.
Segment start, local Pacific clock time, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (an Excel date serial in the source).
Segment end, local Pacific clock time, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (an Excel date serial in the source).
Latitude of the segment start, WGS84.
Longitude of the segment start, WGS84.
Latitude of the segment end, WGS84.
Longitude of the segment end, WGS84.
ON when the on-effort segment ran along a CalCOFI transect line, OFF when on effort but off transect.
notes: the sightings' effort_status; transect_length is published for ON segments only

fld_description: Length of the on-effort segment.
notes: published as sample_measurement transect_length where transect_flag is ON

fld_description: The sighting's own cruise label as recorded (CCYYYY-MM; 202504SH-style for 2025, CC2007-04 where the segments say CC2007-03).
notes: cruise_label is taken from the segment

fld_description: Season of the cruise, lower-cased.
Local date of the sighting (Excel date serial); blank on 7 rows.
Sighting date-time, local Pacific clock time, as YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS (an Excel date serial in the source).
Latitude of the sighting, WGS84.
Longitude of the sighting, WGS84.
On-effort segment the sighting was made on; FK to cetacean_segment.
notes: 2 sightings name segment 419, absent from the segments file

fld_description: Initials of the port-side observer.
Initials of the starboard-side observer.
Sighting-conditions quality code as recorded (E, G, F, P, UX; mixed case).
Visibility as recorded (0-10, one value 66).
Weather / precipitation code as recorded (OV, PC, CL, HZ, LF, ...).
Cloud cover.
Bearing of the glare as recorded.
Second glare bearing as recorded.
Glare severity: SL slight, M moderate, SE severe (also 0, 1, N as recorded).
True wind direction.
True wind speed as recorded (0-317).
notes: units not supplied; one value of 317

fld_description: Beaufort sea state (0-6).
Swell height.
Sighting number within the cruise as recorded (62a / 62b for a split record).
Lab sighting id: survey code + sighting number (CC0407_001, CC202504SH_ 83); not unique (3 ids on 2 rows each).
notes: survey_code and survey_code6 are derived from it

fld_description: Initials of the observer who first saw the group.
Sighting cue code as recorded (0-5).
Ship's true heading at the sighting.
True bearing to the sighting.
Binocular reticle reading to the sighting.
Estimated distance to the sighting.
Observer eye height above the sea surface.
Side of the ship the sighting was on (Port, Star).
Angle between the ship's heading and the sighting, as used in the distance formula.
Intermediate of the reticle-distance calculation.
Intermediate of the reticle-distance calculation.
Intermediate of the reticle-distance calculation.
Intermediate of the reticle-distance calculation.
Intermediate of the reticle-distance calculation.
Intermediate of the reticle-distance calculation.
Radial distance to the sighting computed from the reticle reading and observer height.
Perpendicular distance from the trackline to the sighting, the line-transect distance-sampling measure.
notes: blank on 250 sightings (2025); not published yet

fld_description: Observers' best estimate of the number of animals in the group (per species row for a mixed group).
Observers' minimum estimate of group size.
Observers' maximum estimate of group size.
Number of calves as recorded (0, 1, ..., 001, ND = not determined, and variants; Q09).
Species code as recorded (upper-case, as in the lab's code list).
Second species field; always blank in this delivery (a mixed group is split into a/b rows instead).
Percent of a mixed group that is the first species (100 for a single-species group).
Percent of a mixed group that is the second species.
Observer's original on/off effort flag (always ON in this on-effort product).
Observer's original on/off transect flag.
notes: disagrees with the segment's transect_flag on 284 sightings

fld_description: Primary behaviour code(s) of the group (numeric codes; codebook is Q03).
notes: held (Q03): not published until the codebook arrives

fld_description: Secondary behaviour code(s).
notes: held (Q03): not published until the codebook arrives

fld_description: Observer comments.
Time difference in minutes as recorded (on 1,194 sightings, -1408 to 84425); meaning not supplied.
Species code in the lab's list; species_codes.csv maps it to the vocabulary key species_code.
Common name, from the lab's list (non-breaking spaces removed); species_codes.csv's own name for a code the list lacks.
